title: Explainable machine learning for materials discovery: predicting the potentially formable Nd-Fe-B crystal structures and extracting the structure-stability relationship.
summary: ArXiv v1 directly reports ML stability prediction and structure–stability analysis alongside 20 DFT-screened Nd–Fe–B candidates; candidate formability remains theoretical, not experimental.
